origins.neoorigins.human.name: Kanaka
origins.neoorigins.human.description: He kanaka maʻamau, ʻaʻohe mana kūikawā akā hiki ke hoʻopuni maikaʻi ʻia.
origins.neoorigins.merling.name: Merling
origins.neoorigins.merling.description: He kanaka wai i hānau ʻia ma ke kai ākea - hanu i ka wai a ʻau me ka maʻalahi, akā lohi a maloʻo ma ka ʻāina maloʻo.
origins.neoorigins.avian.name: Avian
origins.neoorigins.avian.description: He lele maikaʻi e neʻe mālie ana, ʻaʻole makaʻu i nā kiʻekiʻe, a nānā i ka honua mai luna mai.
origins.neoorigins.blazeling.name: Ke ʻā nei
origins.neoorigins.blazeling.description: Hānau ʻia e nā ahi o lalo - i hoʻonui ʻia i ka luaʻi pele, hoʻihoʻi ʻia i loko o ke aupuni ʻeleʻele, akā ua make i ka wai a me ka ua.
origins.neoorigins.elytrian.name: Elytrian
origins.neoorigins.elytrian.description: He loea lele maʻemaʻe - lele i ka lewa, ʻaʻole i hoʻopā ʻia e nā mana kinetic, akā palupalu ke kino a hiki ʻole ke lawe i nā mea kaua kaumaha.
origins.neoorigins.enderian.name: Enderian
origins.neoorigins.enderian.description: Hānau ʻia ma nā mokupuni ʻē aʻe o ka End - teleports ma ka makemake, dodges projectiles i loko o ka hakahaka, a hele i ʻike ʻole ʻia e nā endermen.Puhi ka wai e like me ka waika.
origins.neoorigins.arachnid.name: Arachnid
origins.neoorigins.arachnid.description: ʻO ka pūnāwelewele liʻiliʻi e piʻi ana i kekahi pā, lele i ka pūnaewele i nā ʻenemi, a hahau me nā niho - pili i nā mea kolo wāwae ʻewalu o ka honua.
origins.neoorigins.shulk.name: Shulk
origins.neoorigins.shulk.description: ʻO ka pale kaua e like me ka shulker - hoʻokuʻu i nā pupuhi, hoʻi i loko o ka pūpū i ke kihi, a hoʻokuʻu i nā ʻenemi i ka lani me ka levitation pahū.lohi, akā hiki ʻole ke hoʻoluliluli.
origins.neoorigins.phantom.name: Aumiha
origins.neoorigins.phantom.description: ʻO kahi mea nānā - e lele ana i ka pō ma nā ʻēheu elytra, e huki ikaika ana mai ka pepehi ʻana, akā puhi ʻia e ka lā a hiki ʻole ke hoʻomaha.
power.neoorigins.merling_water_breathing: Hanu i lalo o ka wai no ka pau ʻole a ʻike pono i ka wai me ka ʻole o ka noe.
power.neoorigins.merling_aquatic_speed.d: Holo wikiwiki i ka ʻauʻau ʻana.
power.neoorigins.merling_night_vision.de: ʻIke maopopo i ka hohonu hohonu.E hoʻololi me ke kī ʻo Night Vision (paʻamau K).
power.neoorigins.merling_land_slowdown.d: E neʻe 10% mālie ma ka ʻāina.
power.neoorigins.merling_dries_out.name: Māloʻo
power.neoorigins.merling_dries_out.descr: Piʻi ka ea ma waho o ka wai: lōʻihi loa ka ʻili a ʻeha ʻoe.ʻO ka ua, ka ipu wai, ka hanu wai a i ʻole kahi auwai hana kokoke e hoʻopaʻa iā ia.
power.neoorigins.avian_no_fall_damage.de: ʻAʻohe pōʻino mai ka hāʻule ʻana - hopu nā ʻēheu i ka makani.
power.neoorigins.avian_slow_fall.name: Hina Lohi
power.neoorigins.avian_slow_fall.descrip: Hiki ke hoʻololi: e neʻe mālie i lalo.Hoʻopaʻa ʻia e ka paʻamau.E hoʻomanaʻo: pono e hāʻule maʻamau nā hits koʻikoʻi, no laila e mālama i kēia i ka crit.
Hoʻohana i ka 75% emi mai ka ikehu mai nā hana a pau.
power.neoorigins.avian_keen_sight.name: ʻIke Keen
power.neoorigins.avian_keen_sight.descri: ʻOi nā maka - ʻike maikaʻi iki i ka pōʻeleʻele.
power.neoorigins.avian_hollow_bones.name: Iwi Puka
power.neoorigins.avian_hollow_bones.desc: -1 puʻuwai (-2 max HP).Kino māmā, kino palupalu.
power.neoorigins.avian_feather_hop.name: Huluhulu Hop
power.neoorigins.avian_feather_hop.descr: Flutter-lele i luna me ka poha koke o ka eheu.ʻAʻohe uku pōloli.
power.neoorigins.blazeling_fire_immunity: Ka pale ʻana i ke ahi, ka pele, ka pelemaka, a me ka ʻā ʻana - pane ke ahi i loko i ke ahi ma waho.
+3 puʻuwai (+6 max HP).Hoʻopaʻakikī nā papa luaʻi i ke kino.
power.neoorigins.blazeling_nether_born.d: ʻO ka wikiwiki ma ka ʻāina home - neʻe wikiwiki aʻe i ka Nether (ʻaʻohe ikona hopena ʻike ʻia).
power.neoorigins.blazeling_stone_fists.d: ʻAʻohe lima i koʻu lima ma ka ʻāpana stone-pickaxe - haʻi pōhaku, ores, a me netherrack me ka ʻole o nā mea hana.
power.neoorigins.blazeling_internal_heat: Wela ke ahi o loko - ʻoi aku ka wikiwiki o 25% o ka pōloli.
He mea ʻawaʻawa ka wai - 1.5 mau pōʻino i kēlā me kēia kekona i loko o ka wai a i ʻole ka ua.
Hoʻolohe nā maka i ka infrared - ʻike maopopo i ka pōʻeleʻele.E hoʻololi me ke kī ʻo Night Vision (paʻamau K).
power.neoorigins.blazeling_firebolt.name: Puhi ahi
power.neoorigins.blazeling_firebolt.desc: E kiola i kahi pōpō ahi liʻiliʻi ma ke ala āu e nānā nei.Koina 2 ikehu.4-kekona hoʻomaha.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_elytra_boost.d: Loaʻa ka wikiwiki i ka wā e hoʻomaka ai me kahi elytra.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_flight.name: Lele Kūlohelohe
power.neoorigins.elytrian_flight.descrip: Holo e like me ka mea hoʻohana elytra - ʻaʻohe mea e pono ai.E kaomi i ka lele ʻoiai e hāʻule ana e hohola i kou mau ʻēheu.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_flight_speed.d: + 30% ka wikiwiki o ka lele — piʻo ka lani iā ʻoe.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_no_fall.name: Hāʻule hulu
power.neoorigins.elytrian_no_fall.descri: ʻAʻole lawe i ka pōʻino hāʻule.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_no_kinetic.des: ʻO ke kino i ka pōʻino elytra-collision - lele i loko o nā paia me ka hopena ʻole.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_fragile.name: Pākuʻi Nawaliwali
power.neoorigins.elytrian_fragile.descri: Nā iwi manu ʻaʻa - ʻelua mau puʻuwai max.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_no_heavy_armor: 'A'ole hiki ke ha'a i ke kapa kila kaumaha
ʻAʻole hiki ke komo i ka hao, ke gula, ke daimana, a i ʻole nā mea kaua netherite - ʻili a me nā kaulahao wale nō.Pono e māmā nā ʻēheu.
power.neoorigins.strider_stampede.name: hehi
power.neoorigins.strider_stampede.descri: E holo i mua ma nā wāwae mānoanoa.ʻO ke kumu kūʻai 2 stamina.4-kekona hoʻomaha.
power.neoorigins.golem_ground_slam.name: Slam honua
power.neoorigins.golem_ground_slam.descr: Hoʻopaʻa i ka honua me nā lima hao - 4 pōʻino a me Slowness II no 4 kekona i nā ʻenemi āpau kokoke i kahi radius 5-block.He 3 ka ikaika.7-kekona hoʻomaha.
power.neoorigins.enderian_ender_eyes.des: Hoʻokuʻu ʻole ʻo Endermen i kou maka - e nānā iā lākou me ka ʻole o ka hoʻonāukiuki ʻana.
power.neoorigins.enderian_projectile_dod: 50% ka manawa e teleport a pale i ka pōʻino ke hahau ʻia e kahi projectile.
power.neoorigins.enderian_water_damage.d: Lawe i 2 pōʻino i kēlā me kēia kekona mai ka hoʻopili ʻana me ka wai a i ʻole ka ua.
power.neoorigins.enderian_teleport.name: Ender Warp
power.neoorigins.enderian_teleport.descr: Teleport i kahi āu e ʻimi nei - a hiki i 50 mau poloka.Koina 2 ikehu.3-kekona hoʻomaha.
E hoʻopili i kekahi ʻaoʻao kū pololei - e kaomi i ka paia e paʻa, lele e piʻi, paʻa sneak e noho ma kahi.Hōʻalo ʻia ka pōʻino hāʻule i ka wā e hopu ana.
power.neoorigins.arachnid_cobweb_affinit: Ke neʻe nei i loko o nā ʻupena cobweb me ka lohi ʻole a haki koke iā lākou.
power.neoorigins.arachnid_entity_group.d: Helu ʻia ma ke ʻano he arthropod - pōʻino hou mai nā mea kaua Bane of Arthropods.
power.neoorigins.arachnid_spiders_fang.d: Hoʻouka ʻo Melee i ka lāʻau ʻawaʻawa - loaʻa nā pahu hopu i ka Poison I no 3 kekona.
power.neoorigins.arachnid_cobweb_project: Kiola i ka ʻupena cobweb e kau ana iā ia iho i ka hopena, e hoʻopaʻa i nā mea a pau e pae ai.Koina 2 ikehu.
power.neoorigins.shulk_natural_armor.des: Kū'ē Paʻa I - hoʻopaʻa ka pūpū i nā pupuhi e pohā ai ke kino palupalu.
power.neoorigins.shulk_slow_movement.des: Neʻe mālie ma mua o ka maʻamau.
Hoʻoikaika: hoʻokuʻu i ka poha o nā pūpū levitation - lana nā ʻenemi kokoke i luna no 3 kekona.ʻO ke kumu kūʻai 2 stamina.8 kekona hoʻomaha.
power.neoorigins.shulk_shell_retreat.des: Hoʻoikaika: nalo i loko o kou pūpū a ʻike hou ʻia a hiki i 12 mau poloka.He 3 ka ikaika.10-kekona hoʻomaha.
power.neoorigins.shulk_levitation_immuni: Ka pale ʻana i ka levitation - mālama kou pūpū iā ʻoe i ke aʻa ke hoʻi mai nā pōkā.
power.neoorigins.phantom_night_vision.de: Hiki ke ʻike maopopo i ka pōʻeleʻele.E hoʻololi me ke kī ʻo Night Vision (paʻamau K).
power.neoorigins.phantom_water_breathing: ʻAʻole pono e hanu.Hiki ke ola mau loa ma lalo o ka wai.
power.neoorigins.phantom_form.name: Phantom Form
power.neoorigins.phantom_form.descriptio: Lilo i ʻike ʻole ʻia a neʻe me ke kaumaha ʻole.
power.neoorigins.phantom_flight.name: ʻEheu Spectral
power.neoorigins.phantom_flight.descript: Holo e like me ka mea hoʻohana elytra - ʻaʻohe mea e pono ai.E kaomi i ka lele ʻoiai e hāʻule ana e hohola i kou mau ʻēheu.
power.neoorigins.phantom_elytra_boost.de: Loaʻa ka wikiwiki i ka wā e lele ana - holo ikaika nā phantoms i ko lākou mau ʻēheu.
power.neoorigins.phantom_moon_armor.name: Papa mahina
power.neoorigins.phantom_moon_armor.desc: Kū'ē I ma lalo o ka mahina (pō wale nō) - nā pale o ka mahina i ke ʻano spectral.Hoʻopau ka lā i ka pale.
power.neoorigins.phantom_soul_drain.name: Waiwai ʻuhane
power.neoorigins.phantom_soul_drain.desc: E ho'ōla 1 HP i nā manawa a pau e pepehi ai i kahi mea ola.
power.neoorigins.phantom_no_fall.name: Kaumaha ʻole
power.neoorigins.phantom_no_fall.descrip: ʻAʻohe pōʻino hāʻule - ʻaʻole pae nā kino ʻuhane.
power.neoorigins.phantom_sunburn.name: Puhi lā
power.neoorigins.phantom_sunburn.descrip: Hopu i ke ahi a lawe i 1.5 pōʻino i kēlā me kēia kekona i ka lā pololei.
power.neoorigins.phantom_fragile.name: ʻAno Nawaliwali
power.neoorigins.phantom_fragile.descrip: -2 puʻuwai (-4 max HP).He mea maʻalahi ke kino o ka noe e hoʻopau.
power.neoorigins.phantom_no_sleep.name: Makaʻu hiamoe ʻole
power.neoorigins.phantom_no_sleep.descri: ʻAʻole hiki ke hiamoe - ʻo ka pō kāu mea.
origins.neoorigins.feline.name: Feline
origins.neoorigins.feline.description: He kanaka popoki wikiwiki me ka ʻike maka pō a me ka lele ʻana - pae ma ko lākou mau wāwae, hele ma mua o nā ʻīlio hae a me nā ocelots, akā hoʻowahāwahā i ka wai a wela i ka ikehu wikiwiki.
power.neoorigins.feline_no_fall_damage.d: Pae mau me ka maluhia.ʻAʻole lawe i ka pōʻino hāʻule.
power.neoorigins.feline_night_vision.des: Hiki ke ʻike maopopo i ka pōʻeleʻele.E hoʻololi me ke kī ʻo Night Vision (paʻamau K).
power.neoorigins.feline_speed_boost.name: Agile
power.neoorigins.feline_speed_boost.desc: ʻOi aku ka wikiwiki o 10% ma mua o ke kanaka maʻamau.
power.neoorigins.feline_mobs_ignore.name: Ka Maluhia o Predator
